# Gerti Foods

> B2B factory in Prizren, Kosovo supplying bakeries, hotels, restaurants, supermarkets, catering and distributors with ISO 22000 certified half-baked (par-baked) products — pizza, croissants, pies, Danish pastries and tortillas — that finish baking fresh in 15 to 20 minutes.

Gerti Foods is a wholesale producer of half-baked (par-baked) bakery products, founded in January 2024 in Prizren, Kosovo by three partners from the Hasi region, home to more than 600 years of bread-baking tradition. Products arrive frozen and finish baking on-site in 15 to 20 minutes, so a buyer serves oven-fresh product with the same quality on every shift and no in-house baker. The factory combines that heritage with automated European production lines and is certified to HACCP, ISO 22000, IFS, BRC and Halal standards. The company sells B2B only (no consumer retail) and ships across Kosovo, Albania, Hungary, Croatia, Slovakia and Germany.

Production capacity: croissants up to 6,000 pcs/hour, Danish pastries up to 6,000 pcs/hour, tortillas up to 3,000 pcs/hour, frozen pizzas up to 1,300 pcs/hour.

## Products

- [Pizza](https://gertifoods.com/products): half-baked pizza in 7 flavours (Margherita, Pepperoni, Four Cheese, Vegetarian, Tuna and more), in Family and Mini sizes, ready in 15 to 20 minutes.
- [Croissants (Kroasanë)](https://gertifoods.com/products): butter croissants — plain or filled with chocolate or cream. Up to 6,000 pcs/hour.
- [Pies (Pite)](https://gertifoods.com/products): cheese, spinach, meat and tuna pies, consistent in every pack.
- [Danish pastries](https://gertifoods.com/products): half-baked Danish pastry, up to 6,000 pcs/hour.
- [Tortillas](https://gertifoods.com/products): fresh tortillas, up to 3,000 pcs/hour.
- [Family Packs](https://gertifoods.com/products): retail- and home-format multi-piece packs with shelf-appeal packaging.

## Customers Served

- Bakeries: croissants, pies and Danish ready to bake — no dough, no in-house baker.
- Hotels & restaurants (HORECA): pizza and pies in about 20 minutes, a premium menu without a baker on shift.
- Supermarkets & retail: shelf-appeal packaging, fast turnover, higher margin.
- Catering: industrial volumes with on-time delivery and consistent quality per event.

## Agent Tools Available

This site registers WebMCP tools (see [WebMCP documentation](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/ai/webmcp)):

- search_products: search the product catalog by keyword and return up to ten matching products with name, page URL, price and description.
- get_contact_info: return the company's phone, WhatsApp, email and address so a buyer can reach the sales team.
- search_products_form: declarative search form that loads the product results page for a keyword.
